# `fnox deactivate`

- **Usage:** `fnox deactivate`

Turn off shell integration in the current shell

Removes the fnox hook from the current shell session and unsets the secrets it loaded. Other shells and new sessions are unaffected: to turn integration off for good, remove the `fnox activate` line from your shell startup file. To turn it back on in this shell, run the activation command again.

Fails when fnox is not active in the current shell.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

**Turn off the hook in this shell**

```sh
fnox deactivate
```
